welcome_media:
👋 Hi! I fetch openly licensed photos, audio and video and download direct file links.

Supported:
• Wikimedia Commons
• Internet Archive
• a direct link to a media file (.mp4, .mp3, .jpg …) that you have the right to use

Social networks and video platforms are not supported: their terms do not allow downloading.

❓ Help — full guide · 🌐 Language — change language

welcome_video:
👋 Hi! I fetch videos from free-licence libraries: Internet Archive and Wikimedia Commons.

How it works:
1️⃣ Copy a link to a video page
2️⃣ Send it here
3️⃣ Pick a quality: 🎞 video or 🎧 audio only

Every card shows the item's licence, so you know how you may use it.

❓ Help — full guide · 🌐 Language — change language
send_video_link: Please send a link to a video on Internet Archive or Wikimedia Commons.
about_video: Videos from Internet Archive and Wikimedia Commons, with the licence of every item.
help_video: How to get a video 1️⃣ Find a video on archive.org or commons.wikimedia.org. 2️⃣ Send me the link to its page. 3️⃣ I'll show the details, the licence and every available quality. 4️⃣ Tap a button: 🎞 video or 🎧 audio only. Files up to 49 MB arrive right here, bigger ones as a download link. Respect the licence shown on the card (for example, credit the author when it asks for attribution). 🕘 My downloads: your recent files 🌐 Language: change the language
